result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback position: Customer retains a convenience-termination right on timing no worse than the permitted 60–90-day fallback, early-termination charges are capped at three months’ charges, and prepaid charges attributable to the post-termination period are refunded. It does not grant IBM a convenience-termination right. The edits are limited to the fee cap and refund and preserve the original scope and prerequisite-attachment carveout. Drafting is professional, though “three months’ charges” could be defined more precisely and the clause does not achieve the preferred no-fee position.
